change.description: The requested review scope. Null or absent when the runner asked for a full-target review without a change context.

type.description: Change representation reported by the runner; "diff" today.

base_ref.description: Base revision of the reviewed change.

head_ref.description: Head revision of the reviewed change, or the WORKTREE sentinel for the uncommitted worktree.

scan_mode.description: "changed" restricts review to the change; "all" requests the entire target.

changed_files.description: Repository-relative paths the runner identified as changed.
